svg.title: Tell & Wire: the README's picture with the folders and key files of each box
svg.desc: The same three bands as the README's overview: design (the editor and the notebook over common code, with an AI that writes), the project as plain files, and use (a browser, a session host, a graph execution engine, an AI at run time). Each box carries the folders it is and its key files.
svg.text: DESIGN · two products, in your browser
in widgets/<kind>/: how a block is edited
in nodes/<kind>/: how a kind is edited

host and runtime: the code of the USE band below, carried by every package
what it does input.js output.js code.js or prompt.md
The notebook saves these same files: its page is gui.json (words and windows); a window is a row of the schedule.
Read by backend/deployment/project/folder.ts, written by backend/authoring/write.ts; the format of each file is in graph/files/ and gui/gui.ts.
its end of the GUI port
the graph in use; one round at a time

the GUI side of the backend
in nodes/<kind>/: what runs a kind
a code body, in a sandbox
tools for a model, from MCP servers
graph and node files, not the GUI
A block can also watch what a data node holds, with no round started. Two downloads: the full version, and the notebook alone.
